narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Medical Solution -> Routine Adjustment -> Product Selection Advice.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational guide on managing and treating scalp acne. The creator, a professional in skincare, explains the difficulty of treating scalp acne due to hair coverage and suggests a holistic approach: treating facial acne with medication (Isotretinoin) which also benefits the scalp, maintaining frequent washing (especially for oily skin), and choosing the right shampoo (clear, non-conditioning) while avoiding hair oils that can clog pores.
